metadata.description: Obsidian Intelligence Layer — knowledge-layer MCP tooling for AI agent workflows over an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: obsidian-intelligence-layer
plugins.description: Knowledge-layer MCP server for Obsidian vaults: tiered search, graph traversal, mtime-guarded writes, and an audit trail. Ships an optional local-embedding semantic tier that requires Ollama; without it search degrades to keyword tiers rather than failing.
